why: Two mechanisms in the six box failures (write-up docs/forty_two/tasks/fastapi_9753.md). (1) EDIT_TOOL_FAILURE on our line: p4_b1024 read dependencies/models.py at t=45 s and its repro printed the defect at t=218 s, but 152.6 s went to write_file calls that lost their filepath argument (measured, write-up); v13 already removes write_file (lever 1), so this half is v13's. (2) WRONG_LOCATION in the runs that edited: p4, p4_v7 and p4_v7c changed only the two dependencies/utils.py sites of inspect.unwrap( (edits at t=91/99, 45/51 and 52/62 s; submitted at 150, 73 and 107 s), and the base package has exactly three sites of that expression, the third being the gold site models.py:82 (Dependant._unwrapped_call) (MEASURED: docs/forty_two/evidence/fastapi_census.txt section 4). The grep this lever asks for lists the gold site in all three runs, each with 2.5 to 3.8 minutes left. A check written from the issue text alone (docs/forty_two/evidence/fastapi_checks/fastapi_9753.py) is red at base and on all 6 box patches, green on gold and on both L4 solves (MEASURED: docs/forty_two/evidence/fastapi_check_replay.txt). INFERRED: the L4 solves (g4-l4-v4h2g, g4-l4-v5h2-t0, no traces) patched models.py directly, so location is sampled; this lever makes the third site visible whichever site the model edits first.
baseline: Box (A6000, pace proxy, 5 min): p4 (v5h2), p4_v7, p4_v7c, p4_v7d, p4_b1024 (v12-b1024, v13's parent), p4_v0t2 all failed it (0/6). Kaggle L4: 2 of 12 runs with 74 rows solved it. p4_v13 (v13 alone, one sample, box tonight): not yet read when this was written (2026-10-14 22:05 IST; the box log showed 13/74 done, 9753 is the 14th id).
regression_risk: One extra git grep per task that edits: about 7 s of model time on the box (7.3 s per search call on p4_b1024, docs/forty_two/TIMING.md section 4). That matters for solved tasks that finish at or near the cap: on p4_b1024 rich_3506 and rich_3521 made their first source edit at 270-273 s, and fastapi_14458, fastapi_5077, fastapi_5624 and fastapi_14794 were resolved at 305 s through the fallback diff (MEASURED, results.jsonl and fastapi_census.txt section 2). Over-application: a grep that lists look-alike sites doing a different job could lead to extra edits that break pass-to-pass tests (INFERRED; not measurable offline). Inherits v13's text-call risk (below).
also_applies_to: fastapi_5077 (outside the 42): its gold patch makes the same change to globalns = getattr(call, "__globals__", {}) at two sites (MEASURED from data/tasks.jsonl). Any hidden task whose fix repeats at several call sites of one helper or idiom.
text_call_risk: v13 carries a fenced heredoc block in step 3, suspected in the p4_v13 fastapi_14487 row that wrote every tool call as text (B-074). This bundle inherits that block unchanged; the added sentence has no code fence, no backticks and no tool-call syntax (tested). The leak is not new to v13: 5 of 1,783 replies on p4_b1024 (fastapi_14487 among them, at its third reply), 1 on p4_v0t2, 3 on p4 and 1 on p4_v7 carried a native call as text, and every one of those rows recovered after the nudge (MEASURED: scripts/forty_two/text_call_leaks.py, fastapi_census.txt section 3). Read the queue run's traces for zero-call rows before reading its score.
